digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live harness & inbound mapper contract
propositions: Live DC harness must render representative rich-text bodies (heading, bold, code macro) via rebar API and assert rendered HTML output through Jira's renderedFields endpoint, not just wiki source
A second reconcile pass after pushing a rich-text body must exhibit state-based echo-safety (no re-push) when the landed rendered body decodes to an unchanged value

When both rebar and Jira edit the same description field before reconciliation, rebar's value must win (local-wins) and the remote value must be recorded (not clobbered) with a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert
The InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text function must have a stable public contract (signature and behavior) guarded by a cross-repo contract test to prevent breaking imports in agentic-dev-platform
The new live rich-text test must integrate into the existing Dockerized DC-harness CI job without creating a new job and must use existing conftest fixtures and skip markers
